== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Agents For Hire (Virtual Block 8)|Agents For Hire]], release 8.2 of [[Virtual Block 8]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of September 14, 2012". The file was created on 18 October 2012.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf VirtualBlock8_2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020184623/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/2e/Set-VB8.2-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
